coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 5 ground-truth variable items: zero-shot evaluation protocol, FuseLLM versus Llama-2 model comparison, and the Common Sense benchmark.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies seven CS tasks instead of the fixed five-task set and defines the aggregate metric over seven tasks rather than the required Avg.5 Tasks accuracy. Additional controls and optional model arms do not remedy these mismatches.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to report FuseLLM's consistent superiority across all five tasks, its 1.25% relative improvement over Llama-2, and the ARC-challenge (2.40%) and OpenBookQA (2.71%) improvements.
